nodes.name: Schedule Trigger
nodes.notes: Triggers the workflow every day at 9:00 AM.

nodes.name: Fetch High Risk Candidates
nodes.notes: Queries the backend for candidates flagged with high absconding risk (LOW fit score).

nodes.name: Check Risk Count
nodes.notes: Checks if any high-risk candidates were returned.

nodes.name: Format Email
nodes.notes: Formats the raw JSON data into a readable HTML email message.

nodes.name: Send Email Alert
nodes.notes: Sends the formatted alert to the HR team.

nodes.name: No Risks Found
nodes.notes: No action taken if no high-risk candidates are found.
